# Mike Price — MikeSellsUT (Central Utah Real Estate & Rural Property Guides)

> Mike Price is a Central & rural Utah REALTOR® with Heritage Realty Group LLC and an active Utah Certified Residential Appraiser (MK Appraisals, licensed since July 2005; 2026 President-Elect of the Utah Coalition of Appraisal Professionals, UTCAP). Service area: Juab, Sanpete, Millard, and Sevier Counties, Utah. Mailing address: P.O. Box 431, Spring City, UT 84662. Phone: 435-660-0401. Email: mikesellsut@gmail.com.

## Interactive Central Utah Calculators & Checklists

- [Free Tools Hub](https://mikesellsut.com/tools/): Interactive calculators and checklists for Central Utah buyers and sellers.
- [What's My Home or Land Worth? Rough Price Range Tool](https://mikesellsut.com/tools/home-price/): Acreage-tiered starting price range for homes, cabins, HUD-code manufactured homes on land, and vacant land (never relies on price per square foot).
- [Rural Land Buyer & Seller Checklist](https://mikesellsut.com/tools/land-checklist/): Printable due-diligence checklist covering water rights, irrigation shares, wells, septic, access, and zoning.
- [Cabin & Land Total Cost Calculator](https://mikesellsut.com/tools/cabin-cost/): Estimates total project cost including water right + well drilling, septic, and power line extension.
- [Seller Net Proceeds Estimator](https://mikesellsut.com/tools/seller-net/): Estimates net proceeds after loan payoff and closing costs.
- [Rural Utah Loan Chooser](https://mikesellsut.com/tools/loan-chooser/): Compares USDA Rural Development, FHA, conventional, and land loan options.

## Featured Central Utah Pillar Guides (Blog)

- [Water Shares vs. Domestic Well Permits in Central Utah (Juab, Sanpete, Millard & Sevier Counties)](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/water-shares-vs-well-permits-central-utah/): Why two identical 5-acre parcels can sell for tens of thousands of dollars apart, what a standard Utah domestic well allocation covers (1 EDU indoor, ~0.25-acre lawn/garden, and stock water) vs. mutual irrigation company shares in Ephraim, Manti, Mt. Pleasant, Nephi, and Mona, plus pre-contract verification steps.
- [How Much Does a Detached Shop, Barn, or Outbuilding Add to a Home's Sale Price in Central Utah? (+ Nov 2, 2026 UAD 3.6 Rules)](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/detached-shop-barn-outbuilding-sale-price-central-utah/): Construction cost vs. closed-sale market reaction on a 40x60 shop or barn, why price-per-square-foot math misses outbuildings and acreage, horse property zoning in Mona, Nephi, and Sanpete County, and how the Nov 2, 2026 Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac UAD 3.6 appraisal overhaul (900+ data elements per Working RE) documents outbuildings.
- [UAD 3.6 Is Here: What the New Appraisal Report Means for Your Central Utah Sale](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/uad-3-6-new-appraisal-report-central-utah/): Timeline from the Nov 2, 2026 mandate through the June 28, 2027 retirement of legacy forms, new structured fields for outbuildings, water rights, and private roads, and how sellers should prepare.
- [Why Price Per Square Foot Doesn't Work as a Pricing Method in Every Situation](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/price-per-square-foot-doesnt-always-work/): Why dividing price by house square footage fails on rural acreage, outbuildings, and construction types (and why HUD-code manufactured homes must be compared to other manufactured homes, whereas modular homes are built off-site to site-built stick codes and cost more to build and install).
- [How to Price a Horse Property in Juab County (and Why Price Per Square Foot Fails)](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/pricing-horse-property-juab-county/): How land, water shares, animal rights, barns, and arenas drive sale prices in Nephi, Mona, and Levan.
- [How to Price a Rural Property Correctly](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/how-to-price-a-rural-property-correctly/): Adjustment-based comp analysis for Central Utah homes, cabins, and land.
- [Manufactured vs. Modular Homes in Central Utah: Code, Appraisal, and Financing Differences](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/manufactured-modular-homes-central-utah-financing/): HUD-code manufactured homes vs. state-code modular homes, permanent foundation rules, and title retirement.
- [How to Buy Land in Rural Utah: Zoning, Wells, Septic, and Access](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/how-to-buy-land-rural-utah-zoning-wells-septic/): Essential due diligence before buying raw land in Central Utah.
- [Selling Land or Acreage in Central Utah: Why It's Nothing Like Selling a House](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/selling-land-acreage-central-utah/): How to document water, access, and zoning so acreage listings sell.
- [What to Fix Before You List a Rural or Small-Town Home (and What to Skip)](https://mikesellsut.com/blog/what-to-fix-before-listing-rural-home/): Pre-listing repairs that protect loan eligibility and sale price without wasting money.
